source.name: Open Source Psychometrics Project IPIP Big Five Factor Markers
source.licenseNote: Only aggregate statistics are retained; respondent-level data is not committed.

filters: all 50 responses must be integer values from 1 through 5
exclude shared-IP records when IPC is present and not equal to 1
test completion time must be 20–3600 seconds
each item response time must be 100–120000 milliseconds
exclude straight-line responses with one repeated answer

stratification.note: The source file did not provide age and gender columns; only aggregate norms were emitted.
